SELECT
  s99.customer_id,
  s99.customer_first_name,
  s99.customer_last_name,
  s99.customer_email_address
FROM (
  SELECT
    c_customer_id AS customer_id,
    c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
    c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
    c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
    c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country,
    c_login AS customer_login,
    c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
    SUM(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total
  FROM customer
  JOIN store_sales ON c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
  JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE d_year = 1998+1
  GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address
) AS s99
JOIN (
  SELECT
    c_customer_id AS customer_id,
    c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
    c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
    c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
    c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country,
    c_login AS customer_login,
    c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
    SUM(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total
  FROM customer
  JOIN store_sales ON c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
  JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE d_year = 1998
  GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address
  HAVING SUM(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) > 0
) AS s98 ON s99.customer_id = s98.customer_id
JOIN (
  SELECT
    c_customer_id AS customer_id,
    c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
    c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
    c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
    c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country,
    c_login AS customer_login,
    c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
    SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total
  FROM customer
  JOIN web_sales ON c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk
  JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE d_year = 1998
  GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address
  HAVING SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) > 0
) AS w98 ON s98.customer_id = w98.customer_id
JOIN (
  SELECT
    c_customer_id AS customer_id,
    c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
    c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
    c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
    c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country,
    c_login AS customer_login,
    c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
    SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total
  FROM customer
  JOIN web_sales ON c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk
  JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE d_year = 1998+1
  GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address
) AS w99 ON s98.customer_id = w99.customer_id
WHERE CASE WHEN w98.year_total > 0 THEN w99.year_total / w98.year_total ELSE 0.0 END >
      CASE WHEN s98.year_total > 0 THEN s99.year_total / s98.year_total ELSE 0.0 END
ORDER BY
  s99.customer_id,
  s99.customer_first_name,
  s99.customer_last_name,
  s99.customer_email_address
LIMIT 100
